answer: Attestations are weighted by the delta between an agent's claimed and observed behavior across epochs; agents whose scores hit a nadir get slashed and their bond redistributed to honest peers. Sybil resistance via staked identity bonds: each agent must lock a bond that decays with every peer attestation it fails. To harbor a fake identity swarm, an attacker must fund and maintain many bonded agents through repeated slashing, so the cost scales with swarm size, making large-scale sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
